name: Visme AI
tagline: Visme is a visual content platform for creating presentations, infographics, reports, and social media graphics. Its AI Designer generates complete branded presentations from a prompt, while the AI Writer populates slides with relevant content. Marketing and communications teams use it as an alternative to Canva for data-heavy visuals.
